content.short: The TACF NFT Pilot Program is an effort to find alternative and sustainable funding methods for nonprofit organizations.
content.description:
In honor of its 20th Anniversary Global Concert Series, the Taki Alsop Conducting Fellowship (TACF) has released an NFT Pilot Program on the Cardano blockchain.

This Program includes three series: The NFT Ticket Series and two Commemorative Photo Series, the former of which grants holders admission to one of the many TACF 20th Anniversary concerts taking place around the world through 2023. The TACF NFT Program is also an effort to bootstrap non-blockchain industries into the ecosystem.

Our goal is to lead by example in showing that non-profit organizations can find sustainable methods of funding through the use of blockchain technology.
